profile.headline: Software Development Engineer at Abnormal AI
profile.summary: Experienced Software Development Engineer, working with AWS and other cloud services. Skilled in Python (Programming Language), Google Cloud Platform, Java, and TypeScript. Strong engineering professional with a Master of Science in Engineering (MSE) in Computer and Information Science at Penn, and a Bachelor of Science - BS focused in Computer Science from Haverford College.
